bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
page_notes: Sheena jungle adventure. All lettering is italic upper case. Thought balloons (regions 2 and 3) and speech balloons are white with dark lettering, set against very dark panels. Captions are small unboxed or white-boxed italic text with red decorated initials. Some hyphenated word breaks (EX- / PEDITION).

regions.notes: On the page margin above the first panel; red decorated initial 'W'.

regions.text: TRAPPED! YET THERE MUST BE A PASSAGE LEADING OUT!
WHAT DEN OF HORROR IS THIS? THE BONES OF THE CHAINED HUMAN, AND THOSE OF THE LEOPARD TELL A GRISLY TALE! HARK... THOSE SOUNDS AHEAD...
regions.notes: Thought balloon. Drawn 'HARK...THOSE' without a space.
White box, two lines; red decorated initial 'A'.

regions.text: I AM DOCTOR DAFFRON. MY EXPEDITION FOUND THIS TEMPLE A YEAR AGO, BUT A MAN CALLED BROOKS TRAPPED US HERE... TH-THOSE KEYS... WE CANNOT REACH THEM... TOO WEAK...
regions.notes: Lettered 'EX-' / 'PEDITION' across a line break; written whole. 'TH-THOSE' is a stammer with an in-line hyphen, kept. Drawn 'THEM...TOO' without a space.

regions.text: I'VE WAITED A LONG TIME FOR THIS! I'VE OFTEN WONDERED HOW LONG IT TOOK FOR THAT FOOL DAFFRON TO DIE OF SLOW STARVATION.
AH, YOU CHAINED THEM... LEFT KEYS DANGLING JUST OUT OF REACH... AN EXQUISITELY FIENDISH TORTURE, BWANA BROOKS!
SURE! BUT HURRY, WE'VE ANOTHER LOAD TO GET!
HEAR THEM GLOAT, BROTHERS! THEY ARE THE EVIL ONES... NOT SHEENA! WE HAVE BEEN DUPED!
